title: Proactive Memory for Event-Driven LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.36967v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Proactive LLM agents anticipate service opportunities from ongoing observations and accumulated history. Existing approaches emphasize recent context or retrieval of related memories, providing limited support for validating recurring behavioral regularities and assessing their applicability to the current event. We propose Proactive Memory (ProactMem), which organizes history into recent events, temporal trajectories, and behavioral regularities. Trajectory facts are checked against source events, and regularities are assessed through historical replay before being matched to current conditions. We also construct ProactiveStream, a longitudinal benchmark covering three application scopes, where agents process isolated event streams chronologically under episode-aware opportunity labels. On ProactiveStream, ProactMem achieves an overall effectiveness (F1) of 52.6%, a 21.4% relative improvement over the strongest of five external baseline

translated_title: 面向事件驱动大语言模型智能体的主动记忆
translated_abstract: 主动式大语言模型智能体能够从持续的观测和积累的历史中预判服务机会。现有方法侧重于近期上下文或相关记忆的检索，对验证反复出现的行为规律以及评估其与当前事件的适用性方面支持有限。我们提出了主动记忆，它将历史组织为近期事件、时间轨迹和行为规律三个层次。轨迹事实会对照源事件进行校验，行为规律在匹配当前条件之前会通过历史重演进行评估。我们还构建了 ProactiveStream，一个涵盖三种应用范围的纵向基准，智能体在情境感知的机会标签下按时间顺序处理孤立的事件流。在 ProactiveStream 上，ProactMem 实现了 52.6% 的整体效果（F1），相比五个外部基线中最强的一个取得了 21.4% 的相对提升。
tldr: 提出 ProactMem 主动记忆框架，将历史组织为近期事件、时间轨迹和经历史重演验证的行为规律，并构建纵向基准 ProactiveStream，使事件驱动的 LLM 智能体能更准确地预判服务机会，F1 达 52.6%，较最强基线相对提升 21.4%。
en_tdlr: Proposes ProactMem, a proactive memory that organizes history into recent events, temporal trajectories, and replay-validated behavioral regularities, along with a longitudinal benchmark ProactiveStream, enabling event-driven LLM agents to better anticipate service opportunities with 52.6% F1, a 21.4% relative improvement over the strongest baseline.
